attchmntText: VIP Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "VIP Industries Delivers 15% Revenue Growth in Q2, Led by Successful New Product Launches.".
voiceSummary: VIP Industries Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the consolidated income from operations, which rose 15% year-on-year to Rs 468 crore, compared to Rs 406 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. The company reported an EBITDA loss of Rs 27 crore, narrowing from Rs 96 crore in Q2 FY26. Gross margin improved sequentially from 39% in Q1 FY27 to 44% in Q2 FY27. Revenue growth was driven by over 50 new product ranges launched in the first half of FY27, contributing to approximately 45% of hard luggage and backpack sales. The company targets sustained double-digit growth and aims for break-even.

attchmntText: VIP Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: V.I.P. Industries Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 12, 2026. Standalone net loss for the quarter was Rs. 32.69 crore, compared to a profit of Rs. 2.17 crore in the same period last year. Standalone net loss for the half year was Rs. 9.48 crore, versus a loss of Rs. 162.36 crore previously. Consolidated net loss for the quarter was Rs. 30.52 crore, compared to a loss of Rs. 53.56 crore in the prior year. Consolidated net loss for the half year was Rs. 54.08 crore, versus a loss of Rs. 156.24 crore previously. Deloitte Haskins & Sells Chartered Accountants LLP issued review reports stating no material misstatements were found. The results are available on the company website.
